svg.title: Fiche: Scratchboard
svg.desc: Fiche (1D): a microfiche sheet drawn as scratchboard, white lines cut from a black ground: a grid of tiny index frames, each a hatched card, with one frame lifted into the reader's hood and magnified to show a file card numbered CMXCIX. A cursor of cut lines circles a second frame where a child's detail (a bicycle with one training wheel) was matched.
